Water and waste utilities run essential services on aging assets and thin margins: leak detection, network telemetry, customer analytics and regulatory evidence. Non-revenue water alone often pays for the entire instrumented program.

items: SCADA legacy with convergence; NIS2 duties arrive.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Identity & Access Modernization, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Leak detection, Network monitoring, Field operations) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Drinking-water directives among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
